newsitem.title: UK: Euro vegoils lack fresh direction, thin trade seen.
newsitem.headline: Euro vegoils lack fresh direction, thin trade seen.

text.p: European vegetable oil selling levels at midday were unchanged to slightly lower due to a lack of fresh direction, traders said.
"All the market is extremely quiet, not only is it lacking fresh direction but there are very few people participating in it at present," one said.
The palm oil sector attracted the only business of the day so far, and ended the morning session unchanged to $2.50 down.
Aug traded at $512.50 and $552.50 on RBD oil and palm olein respectively. Palm stearin fetched $390 and $392.50 for first week July.
Soy oil dipped by 0.50 guilders to reflect the trend set by Chicago soyoil futures, while rape oil at midday was 0.25 guilders easier to 0.25 firmer.
Lauric oil ended the morning unchanged to $5 below Friday's close.
